name: Basilica of St. Michael the Archangel (Pensacola, Florida)
history: Dominican priests with Tristán de Luna's expedition celebrated the first Mass at Pensacola on 15 August 1559. St. Michael's parish was established in 1781, and the present Gothic Revival church was dedicated in 1886. Benedict XVI named it a basilica on 28 December 2011.
arch: A Gothic Revival church with two front towers of different heights and a pointed-arch entrance.
features: Pensacola marked the 450th anniversary of its first settlement in 2009.
The U.S. Department of the Interior has recognised it as a historically significant landmark.

look.d: The front towers are not the same height.
A pointed window over the door, dedicated in 1886.

fun: The first Mass here was celebrated on the feast of the Assumption in 1559.
journal: 1559: a Mass on the beach. 1886: this Gothic front. Pensacola keeps old time.
